$comment: Automatic cost metering, both bands of the correctness-per-dollar metric. SubagentStop meters each DOER (the cheap 'do' band) from its own transcript. Stop meters the WARBOSS ORCHESTRATOR (the expensive 'decide' band) from the parent transcript once per turn; it appends a cumulative snapshot under a stable per-session agent_id, and `ledger.mjs summary` keeps the last snapshot. Both append to .warboss-horde/ledger.jsonl and read hook JSON (transcript_path, cwd, agent_type, session_id) on stdin. No matcher = fires for every event; WARBOSS_METER_DOER_ONLY=1 restricts the subagent meter to doer dispatches. Both scripts exit 0 on any error so a metering failure never breaks the turn.
